notes.title: Reduced difficulty of pumping!
notes.notes:
The cost of buying new cars has been reduced by 2 times, and the cost of installing new modules (pumping)!
A cheat code for the particularly lazy has been added to the game! It adds +250 coins when entering the code "[b]LAUSH[/b]". You can use the code an unlimited number of times. Whether to use it or not depends entirely on you!

notes.title: Changes in the handling of the car
notes.notes:
In the new update, I decided to make the controls more maneuverable because some negative reviews were precisely because of this. Now, even with stock wheels, cars are managed normally.
Thank you all for your attention!
